## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the soft bread with golden edges and place it in the blackish-gray cast iron skillet.

Task description: Put the soft bread with golden-yellow edges at the lower left of the image into the black-gray cast-iron flat-bottomed pan on the right.

Success criteria: The bread must be inside the skillet, horizontally close to its target position with only small lateral and front-to-back deviations. Both bread and skillet target position must be clearly above the table at the in-skillet placement height.

## Execution tips

- The bread is partly occluded. Consider grasping thick, flatter side regions away from sharp corners, opening slightly wider than local width. Confirm the fingers surround it before closing rather than pressing only its top or gripping a thin edge.
- Use a gentle grasp on the soft bread and make a small lift to observe slipping, adjusting grasp depth as needed to reduce squeezing and dropping.
- Near the pan opening, bring the lowest part of the bread and the fingertips past the rim. Adjust its orientation where there is overhead clearance to avoid hitting the rim and pushing the pan during sideways movement.
- Face the bread’s wider side toward the pan bottom and release only after the bottom supports it. Open the gripper only enough to clear the bread, reducing the risk of the fingertips hitting the pan wall or lifting the bread along with them.
